title: Each invoice appears under exactly one rep or the Unassigned row
refs: SV-8624 (SBR spec v22 2026-08-17 Story 6 S6-R7; §3 Key Decisions)
preconds: 1. A known ZZAUTOTEST invoice set exists across two reps plus at least one unassigned invoice; Show Unassigned is on..
steps:
1. Expand every rep and the Unassigned row.
2. Search the expanded rows for each seeded invoice number.
expected:
1. Every invoice appears under exactly one rep (the rep credited at invoicing time) or under the Unassigned row — never under two rows.
2. The sum of all (N) counts equals the number of matching invoices.

---
